text: AI 额度面板是面向 DSH Web UI 的 Cordis 插件，在侧边栏注册入口，并由 Host 提供同源数据接口。它展示 New API 网关的剩余额度、模型与计费信息、分页调用记录，也可按时间范围分析调用并按官方价目估算用量价值。侧边栏支持刷新额度和显示百分比。适合需要查看团队或个人网关额度与调用情况的 DSH 用户。使用前需配置网关地址和可查询额度及日志的 skey；价目估算可读取 DeepSeek 官方价目表。

AI Quota Panel adds a sidebar panel to the DSH web UI. It displays gateway quota, models, pricing and call logs, with time-range analysis and usage value estimates. Configure a New API gateway and a skey with quota and log access; estimates can use DeepSeek’s public price table.

AI 额度面板的功能「额度概览与侧栏徽标」：在面板查看总额、已用和剩余额度，侧栏显示剩余百分比并可手动刷新。
AI 额度面板的功能「调用分析与价值估算」：选择时间范围分析调用趋势、模型和 Token；另可读取日志并按可编辑价目估算消费金额。
AI 额度面板使用前须知：需提供有额度与日志查询权限的 skey；Host 将其存于本机凭据库，并携带凭据向你配置的网关发起读取请求。（见 index.js:937-980）
AI 额度面板使用前须知：用量价值可通过 Host 读取 api-docs.deepseek.com 的公开价目表，表格用于估算，不代表网关实际结算金额。（见 index.js:901-912）

text: dsh-ai-quota README · 适用：New API 中转站：这个插件就是照着 **New API 系中转站**（自建代理站、团队/公司统一中转、内网 API 网关都算）的接口写的，装的是一站一个 skey，看的是这一站在你名下的额度与调用记录：

dsh-ai-quota README · 适用：New API 中转站：| 项 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 接口契约 | 只读四个中转站自带接口：`/api/usage/token/`（额度）、`/v1/models`（模型）、`/api/pricing`（计费倍率，免鉴权）、`/api/log/token`（调用日志）。不需要在站点改任何配置 |
| 权限前提 | 你的 skey 要能查额度与日志；有的站点对「日志查询」单独开关，查不到时面板会直接把失败原因贴出来 |
| 网络前提 | Host 进程能直连站点地址（内网 / VPN 场景最常见）；不走代理、不跟随重定向 |
| 计价口径 | 金额是**按 DeepSeek 官方价目估算的服务价值**，不等于中转站的实际结算金额；站点配额「点」与货币的换算未经验证，插件不会替你换算 |
| 模型名差异 | 中转站若改了模型名（例如自建别名），用「按模板补价」起草后按站点实际价格改，并在该模型行摘掉「模板价，待核对」标签；官网自动抓取只认官方模型名 |
| 多站点 | 一个 Harness 只保存一套连接（地址 + skey），要换站点在「连接设置」里改地址重填即可 |

dsh-ai-quota README · 适用：New API 中转站：- 界面在浏览器里（React + 主题变量，**不依赖任何 Harness 客户端包**），数据由 Harness 的 Host 进程直连内网网关。
- skey 只存进本机凭据库（Harness `credentials`），**不写浏览器存储、不回传页面**——页面只知道「已配置 / 未配置」。
- 只读：全程只发 GET，不修改网关任何数据。
- 侧边栏与面板标题的**显示名称可自定义**（默认「AI 额度」），见[显示名称](#显示名称)。

侧边栏那一行把剩余额度直接挂在名字后面 —— 点图标即刷新，点文字进面板（截图里的名字是配置出来的，已做脱敏）：

调用记录：服务端分页（20 / 50 / 100 每页）、行内搜索模型名与请求 ID、点行看全部字段：

dsh-ai-quota README · 显示名称：侧边栏那一行和面板标题都用同一个可配置名称，默认是「AI 额度」：

1. 打开面板 → **连接设置** → 「显示名称」。
2. 输入你的名字（最多 40 字符，例如 `AI 额度`、`团队额度`、`研发配额`），**移出输入框或按回车**立即生效——侧边栏那一行和面板标题同时改。
3. 清空即恢复默认「AI 额度」。

实现上它是**纯浏览器偏好**：

- 存在 `localStorage` 的 `dsh-ai-quota/display-name`，不进凭据库、不上传、不影响别人；
- 换浏览器或清缓存后回到默认值；
- 只改名字，不改路由、不改数据，百分比照旧跟在名字后面（`我的额度 · 79%`）。

dsh-ai-quota README · 侧边栏额度百分比：侧边栏那一行显示成 `<显示名称> · 79%`：

| 行为 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 数字含义 | `剩余额度 ÷ 总额度`，四舍五入到整数；无限额度显示 `∞` |
| 自动更新 | 每 15 分钟一次（页面打开期间；关掉标签页即停） |
| 手动更新 | **点那一行的柱状图图标**（不会打开面板，图标转圈 → 绿/红）；点文字才是进面板。面板右上角「刷新」等价 |
| 回到标签页 | 自动更新一次（30 秒节流，避免来回切窗口把网关打满） |
| 查不到就不显示 | 没 skey、网关不通、业务失败、返回里没额度字段 —— 只留名字，绝不留一个过期数字 |
| 清凭据 | 保存/清除 skey 时立刻抹掉数字 |

dsh-ai-quota README · 功能：| 标签页 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| **用量价值** | 默认打开的第一个标签页：已用价值、全部配额估算、剩余配额估算、配额对账**置顶**，下面是分项估算与模型明细，采集与价目设置沉在底部 |
| 连接设置 | 服务器地址、skey 保存 / 从环境变量 `AI_QUOTA_SKEY` 导入 / 清除凭据 |
| 概览 | 总额度、已用、剩余、占比、到期时间（`expires_at <= 0` 显示「暂无限制」）、令牌名、模型限制开关与逐模型上限 |
| 模型与计费 | `/v1/models` 的模型清单与端点类型；`/api/pricing` 的价格表与分组倍率 |
| 调用记录 | 服务端分页（20 / 50 / 100），行内搜索模型名与 request_id，点行看完整字段 |
| 调用分析 | 时间范围 + 时区（UTC / UTC+8）+ 天/小时粒度；Host 分页采集后本地聚合出额度趋势、token 趋势、模型排行、24 小时分布；点柱子钻取明细（50 条/页） |
| 版本历史 | 每个版本改了什么 |
dsh-ai-quota README · 功能：调用分析是「采集 + 本地聚合」：Host 从第 1 页顺着翻，直到拿到不满 50 条的页为止（网关唯一的结束信号），按 `id` 去重并统计范围外/重复/冲突条数，再按粒度和时区聚合。保护上限 20000 页 / 200000 条 / 30 分钟，触顶时状态行会说明结果可能不完整。

dsh-ai-quota README · 用量价值：| 环节 | 规则 |
| --- | --- |
| 采集范围 | 默认采集**今天往前两周**（UTC+8，含今天）；勾「全部时间」才翻完所有页，也可自选起止日期（最长 366 天）。网关分页是新到旧，翻到整页都比范围更早即**提前结束**（两天范围实测 24 页收工，全量 92 页）；触到本机上限才算「不完整」 |
| 只算消费 | 日志 `type = 2` 才计价；`type = 4 / 5`（失败请求）与其他记录分开统计，不重复计费 |
| 三段 token | 命中 = `cache_tokens`（缺失时用 `cached_tokens`，都没有按 0）；未命中 = `输入 − 命中`（命中大于输入直接报错停止）；输出 = `completion_tokens`。`cache_write_tokens` 不叠加进输入 |
| 高峰判定 | 工作日且 UTC 01:00–04:00、06:00–10:00 → 高峰价；其余时段、周末、你列出的法定节假日 → 优惠价 |
| 计价 | `(命中×命中价 + 未命中×未命中价 + 输出×输出价) ÷ 1,000,000`，每个模型用自己的价目，查不到价格的模型单独列出、绝不套用别的模型价 |
| 模板价 | 未知型号可点「按模板补价」起草（借 Flash / V4-Pro 的价目），但那一行会挂「模板价，待核对」标签，改一个数字即摘掉——借用别人的费率必须写在脸上 |
| 重试 | 每页最多请求 3 次（间隔 700ms / 1400ms）再判失败：几十页的长跑不该被一次网络抖动清空 |
| 汇率 | 由「价目货币」决定口径：价目是元时人民币列就是价目本身、汇率只换算美元列；价目是美元时才反过来。默认 6.66（2026-11-02 公开市场价：open.er-api 6.6609 / exchangerate-api 6.66 / ECB 10-30 交叉 6.6529；同日 CFETS 中间价 6.7146） |
| 价目来源 | 内置快照 **official-2026-11-02**，官方人民币价目：`deepseek-flash` 高峰 0.04 / 2 / 8、空闲 0.02 / 1 / 4；`deepseek-v4-pro` 高峰 0.30 / 9 / 27、空闲 0.15 / 4.5 / 13.5。点「从官网更新价目」由 Host 实时读官方 Markdown 价目页解析，成功即替换并标注抓取时间，失败保留当前价目并显示原因；存着旧快照会被新快照替换（版本号变化即迁移） |
| 官方口径 | 空闲价 = 高峰价的一半；高峰为北京时间工作日 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（= UTC 01–04 / 06–10，与

dsh-ai-quota README · 用量价值：价目、汇率、节假日都存在**本浏览器** `localStorage`（`dsh-ai-quota/value-v1`），不进凭据库、不上传。

面板对网关只调用四个只读接口（`/api/usage/token/`、`/v1/models`、`/api/pricing`、`/api/log/token`），不改额度、不动配置；唯一的对外请求是「从官网更新价目」时读 `api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing.md`。

真实网关对过一遍：同一个 token，插件这边 89 页 / 4436 条采集完成，非高峰 token 合计 `145,208,707`，失败记录 101 条，峰值 / 非高峰分桶与独立核对脚本逐位一致，配额对账差 0.075%（一致性阈值内）；官方价目页也实测解析出 `deepseek-flash` / `deepseek-v4-pro` 两个模型、CNY 口径，与内置快照一致。

dsh-ai-quota README · 安装：前提：本机有 DeepSeek Harness（Web UI 可用）。

**一句话装**（从 npm 取最新版，不用 clone）：

```
plugin_manager  install_bundle  target = dsh-ai-quota
```

装完刷新 Web UI，侧边栏面板区出现「AI 额度」图标（位置在「插件 / 自动化任务」之后）。

> 国内网络如果卡在 registry 上，可以指定源：`install_bundle` 传 `registry = https://registry.npmjs.org`（国内镜像 npmmirror 对新包有几分钟同步延迟）。

从源码装（要改代码时用）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/hustwxw/dsh-ai-quota.git
```

```
plugin_manager  install_bundle  target = <克隆目录的绝对路径>
```

dsh-ai-quota README · 安装：开发时改动 `client.js` 后刷新页面即可生效；改动 `index.js`（Host 半）需要重启 Harness。装了依赖的 pnpm store 里 React 18 时，`npm test` 里的渲染测试与 DOM 测试才会真正跑，否则自动 SKIP：

```powershell
$env:DSH_NODE_MODULES = "F:\AI\deepseek-harness\deepseek-harness\node_modules"   # 任何带 react18 + jsdom 的 node_modules
npm test
```

dsh-ai-quota README · 安装：测试分五层：`host-test.mjs` 用假网关跑真 Host（含价值估算、CNY/USD 口径与对账）、`pricing-test.mjs` 拿官方价目页样本喂解析器（含 4 种拒绝场景）、`locale-check.cjs` 校验中英文字典键、`render-test.mjs` 用 React 18 服务端渲染每个标签页、`value-dom-test.mjs` 在 jsdom 里把「采集 → 估价 → 渲染 → 改汇率重算 → 抓官网价目 → 迁移旧快照」整条链路走一遍。

不想手打命令？把[文首那段提示词](#-一键安装把下面整段复制给你的-dsh)直接发给对方的 DSH，它会自己装完并验证。

前置条件只有两条：目标机器装了 DSH 且 Web UI 可用；能访问你自己的 New API 网关（内网 / VPN）。

dsh-ai-quota README · 安装：如果 npm 那条路走不通（内网、镜像没同步、CDN 缓存 404），退回源码安装：`git clone https://github.com/hustwxw/dsh-ai-quota`，再把 `install_bundle` 的 target 设成克隆目录的绝对路径。

npm 包主页：<https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ai-quota>

dsh-ai-quota README · 配置：1. 侧边栏 → AI 额度 → 连接设置。
2. 服务器地址：只接受 `http(s)://主机:端口`，带路径会被拒绝；留空用默认值。
3. 填 skey 保存；或先把 skey 放进环境变量 `AI_QUOTA_SKEY`，再点「从环境变量导入」。
4. 保存后概览会自动拉一次；某块失败只影响那一块，原因显示在对应卡片下方。

默认网关地址是占位值 `http://newapi.example.com`（写在 `index.js` 的 `DEFAULT_BASE_URL`）。首次使用时在「连接设置」里填你自己的 New API 地址即可；想让默认值就是自己的地址，改这一行常量。

dsh-ai-quota README · 数据与隐私：- skey 存于凭据库键 `ai-quota/default`（`kind: api-key`），服务器地址存在同一条记录的 `env.AI_QUOTA_BASE_URL`。
- 显示名称只写 `localStorage`（`dsh-ai-quota/display-name`），不进凭据库、不上传。
- 页面通过同源 `POST /x-ai-quota/...` 与 Host 通信，请求要过 Harness 的连接校验；凭据本体不出 Host。
- 调用分析的行数据只存在 Host 内存里，任务上限 4 个，Host 重启即清空。
- 网关响应按字段白名单裁剪后才回给页面（额度 8 个字段、模型 2 个、价格 7 个、日志 12 个），未知字段不会进 UI。

dsh-ai-quota README · 接口契约：- 只调用四个只读接口：`GET /api/usage/token/`、`GET /v1/models`、`GET /api/pricing`（不带鉴权）、`GET /api/log/token`。
- 20 秒超时、不走代理、不跟随重定向、响应上限 8 MiB；**HTTP 200 也可能是业务失败**，所以逐个接口校验 `code` / `success`。
- 分页 1-based，`page_size` 只能取 20 / 50 / 100；分析窗口用 `[start, end)`，`end` 传「最后一秒 + 1」。
- 缺字段就是缺，不补 0：界面上的「未返回」表示接口没给这个字段。

dsh-ai-quota README · 已知限制：- 调用分析必须把范围内的日志全量翻一遍，数据量大时耗时长（每页间隔 300 ms，避免压垮网关）。
- 24 小时分布、模型排行和趋势图都基于同一次采集；切换模型筛选会重新聚合，但不重新采集。
- 百分比只反映令牌级剩余额度，不按模型拆分。

dsh-ai-quota README · 开发与测试：```powershell
node tests/host-test.mjs      # Host 半：假网关跑通 4 个接口、白名单、分页、采集与聚合
node tests/locale-check.cjs   # 注册 2 个槽位、中英字典 148 键对齐、没有死键
node tests/render-test.mjs    # 用真 React 18 渲染 37 个用例（需要 React 18，见下）
```

`tests/host-test.mjs` 会起一个监听随机端口的假网关（4 个接口 + 120 条日志），把 `index.js` 装进假 ctx 后从头到尾跑一遍，**不碰真实网关也不需要 skey**。

text: dsh-ai-quota README · Built for New API relay stations：The plugin is written against the endpoints a **New API relay station** ships with — a self-hosted proxy, a team or company gateway, an intranet API relay. One station, one skey, and the panel shows the quota and call log that station holds for you.
section: Built for New API relay stations

text:
dsh-ai-quota README · Built for New API relay stations：| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Contract | Four read-only station endpoints only: `/api/usage/token/` (quota), `/v1/models` (models), `/api/pricing` (ratios, no auth), `/api/log/token` (call log). Nothing has to be enabled or changed on the station |
| Permissions | The skey must be allowed to read quota and logs; some stations gate log access separately, and a failure is shown verbatim rather than hidden |
| Network | The Host process must reach the station (intranet / VPN is the usual case); no proxy is used and redirects are not followed |
| Pricing | Amounts are the service value at **DeepSeek's published list price**, not what the relay settles; the quota-point-to-currency conversion is unverified, so the panel never makes it up |
| Model names | If a station renames models (its own aliases), draft the row with **Fill from the template** and correct it to the station's own rates, which clears the "template price, unverified" tag. The official-page fetch only knows official model names |
| Several stations | One Harness keeps one connection (address + skey); point Connection at another station to switch |
section: Built for New API relay stations

text:
dsh-ai-quota README · Built for New API relay stations：- The UI runs in the browser (React + theme tokens, **importing no Harness Client package**), while the data is fetched from the gateway by the Harness Host process.
- The skey lives in the local credential store (Harness `credentials`). It is **never written to browser storage and never sent back to the page** — the page only learns whether one is configured.
- Read-only: the plugin only ever issues GETs and never writes to the gateway.
- The display name of the sidebar row and the panel title is **configurable** (default `AI Quota`), see [Display name](#display-name).

dsh-ai-quota README · Display name：The sidebar row and the panel title share one configurable name, `AI Quota` by default:

1. Open the panel → **Connection** → **Display name**.
2. Type a name (40 characters max, e.g. `AI Quota`, `Team quota`, `R&D quota`) and **leave the field or press Enter** — the sidebar row and the panel title both change at once.
3. Clear the field to fall back to the default.

It is a **browser-local preference**:

dsh-ai-quota README · Sidebar percentage：| Behaviour | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Meaning | `remaining ÷ granted`, rounded to an integer; an unlimited quota shows `∞` |
| Auto refresh | Every 15 minutes while the page is open; closing the tab stops it |
| Manual refresh | **Clicking the row's bar-chart icon** (does not open the panel; the icon spins, then turns green/red); clicking the text opens the panel. Refresh in the panel is the same action |
| Coming back to the tab | One refresh, throttled to one per 30 seconds so tab switching cannot hammer the gateway |
| Hidden when unknown | No skey, unreachable gateway, business failure, or a payload without quota fields — the name stays, a stale number never does |
| Cleared credential | Saving or clearing the skey drops the number immediately |

dsh-ai-quota README · Features：| Tab | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| Connection | Server address, save the skey, import it from `AI_QUOTA_SKEY`, clear the credential, set the display name |
| Overview | Granted, used, remaining, usage ratio, expiry (`expires_at <= 0` reads as "no expiry"), token name, model-limit switch and per-model limits |
| Models & pricing | Model list and endpoint types from `/v1/models`; the price table and group ratios from `/api/pricing` |
| Call log | Server-side paging (20 / 50 / 100), in-page search over model name and request_id, click a row for every field |
| Analysis | Date range + time zone (UTC / UTC+8) + day or hour granularity; the Host pages through the log and aggregates locally into quota trend, token trend, model ranking and a 24-hour histogram; clicking a bar drills into the rows (50 per page) |
| **Usage value** | The first and default tab: spend, whole-quota estimate, remaining-quota estimate and reconciliation at the very top, the breakdown and model detail below, collection and the price table at the bottom |
| Versions | What each release changed |

dsh-ai-quota README · Features：Analysis is "collect, then aggregate locally": the Host walks pages from 1 until a page comes back short of 50 rows (the gateway's only end signal), de-duplicates by `id`, counts rows that fall outside the range / repeat / conflict, and aggregates by granularity and time zone. Guard rails are 20 000 pages, 200 000 rows and 30 minutes; hitting one says so in the status line rather than silently truncating.

dsh-ai-quota README · Usage value：The arithmetic follows DeepSeek's published price list and billing windows; the panel collects by itself and re-prices on every edit, so no script has to be run by hand.

dsh-ai-quota README · Usage value：| Step | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Collection | Collects **the last two weeks by default** (UTC+8, today included); tick "All time" to page through everything, or pick your own dates (at most 366 days). The gateway pages newest-first, so a walk stops **as soon as a whole page falls before the window** (24 pages for two days versus 92 for everything); only a local cap counts as truncated |
| Consumption only | Only `type = 2` rows are priced; `type = 4 / 5` (failed requests) and other records are counted apart so nothing is billed twice |
| Three token kinds | Hit = `cache_tokens` (falling back to `cached_tokens`, then 0); miss = input − hit (hit greater than input stops the run with an error); output = `completion_tokens`. `cache_write_tokens` is never added to the input |
| Peak test | A weekday inside 01:00–04:00 or 06:00–10:00 UTC is peak; every other hour, weekends and the public holidays you list are off-peak |
| Pricing | `(hit × hit rate + miss × miss rate + output × output rate) ÷ 1,000,000`, each model at its own rates; a model without a price is listed on its own and never borrows another model's rate |
| Template rates | An unknown model ca

dsh-ai-quota README · Usage value：The table, the rate and the holiday list live in **this browser's** `localStorage` (`dsh-ai-quota/value-v1`) — not in the credential store, never uploaded. The default table (USD per million tokens, entered 2026-11-02) is only a starting point: check it against the DeepSeek pricing page before relying on it (`deepseek-chat` / `deepseek-reasoner` peak 0.028 / 0.28 / 0.42, off-peak at half of that).
dsh-ai-quota README · Usage value：The panel only calls four read-only endpoints (`/api/usage/token/`, `/v1/models`, `/api/pricing`, `/api/log/token`); it never changes a quota or a setting.

dsh-ai-quota README · Install：If npm is not an option (intranet, mirror lag, a CDN-cached 404), fall back to source: `git clone https://github.com/hustwxw/dsh-ai-quota` and point `install_bundle`'s target at that directory's absolute path.

npm page: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ai-quota>

dsh-ai-quota README · Configuration：1. Sidebar → AI Quota → Connection.
2. Server address: `http(s)://host[:port]` only; a path is rejected. Empty means the default.
3. Paste the skey and save, or export it as `AI_QUOTA_SKEY` first and use **Import from environment**.
4. The overview fetches once after saving. A failing section only affects that section; the reason shows under its card.

dsh-ai-quota README · Configuration：The default gateway address is the placeholder `http://newapi.example.com` (the `DEFAULT_BASE_URL` constant in `index.js`). Point it at your own New API instance either in the Connection tab or by editing that constant.

dsh-ai-quota README · Data & privacy：- The skey is stored under the credential key `ai-quota/default` (`kind: api-key`); the server address rides the same record as `env.AI_QUOTA_BASE_URL`.
- The display name only ever touches `localStorage` (`dsh-ai-quota/display-name`); never the credential store, never the network.
- The page talks to the Host over the same-origin `POST /x-ai-quota/...` route, which passes the Harness connection check; the credential itself never leaves the Host.
- Analysis rows live in Host memory only; at most 4 jobs are kept and a Host restart clears them.
- Gateway responses are trimmed by field allowlist before reaching the page (8 quota fields, 2 model fields, 7 pricing fields, 12 log fields), so unknown fields never show up in the UI.

dsh-ai-quota README · API contract：- Exactly four read-only endpoints: `GET /api/usage/token/`, `GET /v1/models`, `GET /api/pricing` (no auth), `GET /api/log/token`.
- 20 s timeout, no proxy, no redirect following, 8 MiB response cap; **HTTP 200 can still be a business failure**, so the `code` / `success` flag is validated per endpoint.
- Paging is 1-based and `page_size` is restricted to 20 / 50 / 100; the analysis window is `[start, end)` with `end` sent as "last second + 1".
- A missing field stays missing — the UI shows "not returned" instead of inventing a zero.

dsh-ai-quota README · Known limitations：- Analysis has to walk every log row in range, so a large window takes a while (300 ms between pages to keep the gateway responsive).
- The 24-hour histogram, model ranking and trends all come from one collection; changing the model filter re-aggregates but does not re-collect.
- The percentage reflects the token-level remaining quota; it is not split per model.
